paraphrase: Declare the target audience accurately in Play Console; child-directed imagery or wording can change Google's assessment regardless of the declaration, and misrepresentation can lead to removal. If children are a target audience: content must be appropriate for them; the app may not be a mere webview or affiliate funnel; all Play Console answers (target audience, Data safety, IARC) must be accurate; collection of children's personal and sensitive data, including via SDKs, must be disclosed; child-only apps may not transmit persistent identifiers such as AAID or IMEI, may not request location permission or collect precise location, and may not use SDKs unapproved for child-directed services (mixed-audience apps may only use them behind an age screen); social features need an online-safety reminder, adult controls and adult action before children share personal data; the app and its SDKs must comply with COPPA, GDPR and other laws; ads to children must come only from Families self-certified SDKs, never be interest-based or remarketed, be child-appropriate, and follow the Families ad format rules; mixed-audience apps must implement age screening such as a neutral age screen; and the privacy policy must accurately describe data practices.
